verdict.rationale: YPOG's own notary unit offers a "Questionnaire for the preparation of a GmbH/UG foundation" and a "Starterkit GmbH-foundation", and the firm markets advice "from inception to exit." That documents company formation as a firm service. The specific deliverables in the story (charter/articles, bylaws, initial board consents, founder stock purchase) are not described, and formation is not shown as a core practice offering. Missing for 10: explicit formation-package documentation covering articles/charter, bylaws, initial board consents and founder share purchase, formation positioned as a core emerging-companies service, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can engage the firm to incorporate my company — charter, bylaws, initial board consents, and founder stock purchase — documented as a core of its startup/emerging-companies practice

citations.quote: Questionnaire for the preparation of a GmbH/UG foundation
Well advised from inception to exit.
